{{Top|leg}}
The '''Baragwin stun ray''' was a standard [[stun ray]] that had been modified by the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] to efficiently run off of the mounting [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] power supply. While is was not considered a powerful weapon, the modification did eliminate the need to replace the device due to overuse.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
